Interface VirtualViewRmi

All Superinterfaces:
Remote, VirtualView
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiClient
public interface VirtualViewRmi extends VirtualView, Remote
RMI-flavored VirtualView. Every method redeclares its parent to throw RemoteException, as required by the Remote contract.
